Page.signature: Page(blocks: (Heading | Text | CodeBlock | Callout | Steps | Diagram | Artifact)[])
Page.description: The whole page: its blocks, top to bottom, in one column. Always the root.

Heading.description: A heading inside the page. The page title is already shown, so use level 2 for sections and 3 for subsections.

Text.description: Running text in Markdown: paragraphs, lists, **bold**, `inline code`, links and tables. No headings and no code fences here.

CodeBlock.signature: CodeBlock(code: string, language?: string, title?: string)
CodeBlock.description: A block of code with a copy button. Name it by its file (title) or its language.

Callout.description: A note set apart from the text: note, tip, important, warning or caution. Its text is Markdown. Never two in a row.

Steps.description: Numbered steps for a procedure the reader follows in order.

StepItem.description: One step: a short title and its explanation in Markdown.

Diagram.signature: Diagram(label: string, svg: string, caption?: string)
Diagram.description: A small static drawing as a self-contained SVG string (viewBox, no scripts, no external images), with a label that says in words what it shows. Use mid greys that read on light and dark backgrounds.

Artifact.signature: Artifact(title: string, html: string, height?: number)
Artifact.description: The escape hatch, for what the other components cannot show (an interactive widget, a simulation). A self-contained HTML document with inline CSS and JS, run in a sandboxed iframe with no network access. Use it rarely.
